about: Hand-edited list of live cams for Surftracker (/sd/surf/cams). Only YouTube streams whose operators allow embedding, checked 2026-11-27 (shared notes: surftracker-cams.md). Never add Surfline-owned cams, HDOnTap streams without permission, or Earth Watch Live until its ownership is confirmed. Fields: id (unique), name, kind ('surf' or 'harbour'), area, youtube (video id), operator {name, url}, covers (spot ids in view: their break pages get a 'Live cam' link), near (nearest breaks, not in view), note (optional). src/surf/cams.py checks each cam daily and writes surf_cams_status.json.
